assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope
The episodes raise concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis code I49.9 is assigned
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The required precertification was never obtained
The payer letter cites the authorization as the basis for denial of CPT 93229
